title: Twisted Alexander polynomial and Reidemeister torsion
note: Pacific J. Math. 174(2) (1996), 431-442. Verified via Crossref REST API (DOI 10.2140/pjm.1996.174.431) and MSP open-access text (2026-11-28). Proves Wada's twisted Alexander polynomial of a knot exterior for an acyclic SL_n-representation equals its Reidemeister torsion (Theorem A) and is reciprocal/symmetric for SO(n)-representations (Theorem B).
